units.title: SG-2.6 · Create the asset files that manifest.json references
Act: Add the nine SVG assets under game/public/assets/worlds/the-boys-room
Verify: SVG assets resolve with manifest dimensions unit tests

tests.id: publicAssetSvgs.test.ts::every svg path exists under public/assets
tests.name: every svg path exists under public/assets
tests.title: Every SVG asset in the manifest exists under public/assets
tests.scenario: Given the-boys-room manifest.json with nine worlds/ SVG entries, When each path is resolved under public/assets, Then none is missing
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/publicAssetSvgs.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.id: publicAssetSvgs.test.ts::svg width and height match manifest dimensions
tests.name: svg width and height match manifest dimensions
tests.title: SVG width and height attributes match manifest dimensions
tests.scenario: Given each manifest SVG entry with dimensions, When the svg width and height attributes are parsed, Then they equal the manifest width and height
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/publicAssetSvgs.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: svg is crispEdges
tests.title: Each SVG is an svg element with crispEdges shape rendering
tests.scenario: Given each manifest SVG file, When its content is read, Then it contains an <svg element and shape-rendering="crispEdges"
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/publicAssetSvgs.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

units.title: Verify: ambient-room.wav resolves and has a RIFF header unit tests

tests.id: publicAssetAudio.test.ts > file exists and is non-empty
tests.name: file exists and is non-empty
tests.title: the-boys-room audio asset > file exists and is non-empty
tests.scenario: Given the manifest entry audio:ambient-room, When its path is stat'ed under the public assets root, Then the size is greater than 0

tests.name: has RIFF WAVE header
tests.title: the-boys-room audio asset > has RIFF WAVE header
tests.scenario: Given the manifest entry audio:ambient-room, When the WAV is read, Then bytes 0-4 are 'RIFF' and bytes 8-12 are 'WAVE'
tests.detail: Passes: header ascii checks match RIFF and WAVE
